en.headline: URA awards Hung Hom Bailey Street project to China Overseas for HK$6.9 billion
en.dek: Top Global Investment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Overseas Land & Investment, won the development contract after seven tenders were received.
body: The Urban Renewal Authority has awarded the development contract for its Bailey Street / Chi Kiang Street Project in Hung Hom to Top Global Investment Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of China Overseas Land & Investment Limited, for HK$6.902 billion.

Seven tenders were received by the deadline on 27 July. After assessment by a tender review panel under the URA Board, the Board approved the award to the China Overseas subsidiary. Other tenderers included subsidiaries or consortia linked to Wharf, CK Asset, Chinachem, Kerry Properties, Sino Land, Great Eagle, K. Wah and Sun Hung Kai Properties.

The site at the junction of Bailey Street and Chi Kiang Street covers about 7,610 square metres and has been rezoned for residential use. The project aims to maximise development potential while integrating with the adjacent waterfront and improving connections to inland areas. Unsuccessful tender amounts will be published anonymously after the contract is executed.

zh.headline: 市建局紅磡庇利街項目批予中海 投標價69.02億元
zh.dek: 中國海外發展全資附屬公司偉國投資投得發展合約，共接獲七份標書。
body: 市區重建局宣布，紅磡庇利街／浙江街項目的發展合約已批予中國海外發展有限公司全資附屬公司偉國投資有限公司，投標價為69.02億港元。
市建局於7月27日截標時共接獲七份標書。標書評審委員會評估後向市建局董事會推薦，董事會其後批准將合約批予中海外附屬公司。其他投標者包括與九龍倉、長江實業、華懋、嘉里建設、信和、鷹君、嘉華及新鴻基等地產商有關的公司或財團。
項目位於庇利街與浙江街交界，地盤面積約7,610平方米，已由主要「政府、機構或社區」地帶改劃為住宅用途。市建局指項目將善用發展潛力，並與毗鄰海濱融合，同時改善與內陸地區的連接。市建局將在與中標者簽訂合約後，以不記名方式公布落選標書的投標價。
